lighting_shading.note: Bright upper surfaces contrast with deep shadows beneath the dock.

value_contrast.note: White lifebuoy bands punctuate warm wood and dark underwater supports.

color_palette.note: Red lifebuoy accents orange timber against vivid turquoise water.

composition_hierarchy.note: Foreground lifebuoy dominates; rope-wrapped rear post provides a secondary focus.

shape_proportions.note: Thick ropes, rounded timber, and inflated ring create substantial toy-like forms.

viewpoint_depth.note: Overlapping posts, diagonal planks, water, and shoreline establish layered depth.

edges_linework.note: Clean contours and sparse wood grooves define forms without outlines.

surface_finish.note: Smooth rubber, simplified wood grain, and twisted rope distinguish materials.

pose_rhythm.note: Repeated rope coils and planks animate an otherwise still dock.
